synth.notes:
Arrows translate the selected axis or piece by one 3x3 cell; A5 cycles column axis, row axis, pieces.
Pieces obey board bounds and real-piece collisions; targets and the counter remain logically fixed.
Row-axis mirrors are gray; column-axis and double mirrors erase underlying rings.
Column-axis contact makes the whole piece's row mirror invisible, explaining the final counterexample.
Layer composition and component ranking reproduce names/pixels; clicks and reset are unobserved.
